design_description: A bold red football jersey featuring a subtle geometric brickwork pattern inspired by architectural textures. Navy blue side panels, gold detailing, and a navy-and-gold crew neck create a refined contrast. The Suministros Rubia club crest sits on the chest alongside the white Momuto logo, while the large white SUMINISTROS RUBIA sponsor dominates the center. Matching navy-and-gold sleeve trims and regional football patches complete a clean, distinctive design.
